name: dbt-prism
description: Semantic SQL & dbt autocompletion engine with CTE and schema.yml lineage

enumDescriptions: Jump first to the table/alias declaration in the local FROM or JOIN clause, then Ctrl+Click the ref() or CTE name to open the source.
Jump directly to the source dbt model file (.sql) or CTE declaration.
dbtPrism.goToDefinition.tableTarget.description: Controls where Ctrl+Click (Go to Definition) navigates when clicking a table qualifier in a query (e.g. 'cus' in 'SELECT cus.id').
